item.title: Geneva City Schools hires new head football coach
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Geneva City Schools has announced Donnie Smith as the Geneva Panthers new football coach. Coach Smith has previously served Geneva City Schools in teaching, coaching and administration positions. “I am fully confident in the job Coach Smith will do both on and off the field,” said Superintendent Jami Seay.

item.title: Alabama DHR to block out-of-state and online EBT purchases by default
item.description: The Alabama Department of Human Resources announced on Monday that a new system will automatically block all EBT card transactions outside of the state and online.
